text: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD {YHWH} came to him (whom YHWH has appointed) a second time:
“Thus says the LORD {YHWH} who made the earth [who made it], the LORD who formed it and established it, the LORD is His name:
Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.

For this is what the LORD, the God {YHWH Elohe} of Israel (he wrestles with God), says about the houses of this city and the palaces of the kings of Judah (praised) that have been torn down for defense against the siege ramps and the sword:

The Chaldeans (clod-breakers) are coming to fight (They are coming to fight the Chaldeans) and to fill those places with the corpses of the men I will strike down in My anger and in My wrath. I have hidden My face from this city because of all its wickedness.
Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
I will restore Judah (praised) and Israel (he wrestles with God) from captivity (restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel) and will rebuild them as in former times.
And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.

So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.

This is what the LORD {YHWH} says: In this place you⁺ say is a wasteland without man or beast, in the cities of Judah (praised) and in the streets of Jerusalem (city of peace) that are deserted—inhabited by neither man nor beast—there will be heard again

the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD {YHWH}, saying: ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good; His loving devotion endures forever.’ For I will restore the land from captivity (restore the fortunes of the land) as in former times, says the LORD.
This is what the LORD {YHWH} of Hosts says: In this desolate place, without man or beast, and in all its cities, there will once more be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.

In the cities of the hill country, the foothills {Shephelah}, and the Negev (southland), in the land of Benjamin (son of the right hand) and the cities surrounding Jerusalem (city of peace), and in the cities of Judah (praised), the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the LORD {YHWH}.
Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD {YHWH}, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel (he wrestles with God) and the house of Judah (praised).
In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David (beloved) a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
In those days Judah (praised) will be saved, and Jerusalem (city of peace) will dwell securely, and this is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness {YHWH Tsidqenu}.
For this is what the LORD {YHWH} says: David (beloved) will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel (he wrestles with God),
nor will the priests who are Levites ever fail to have a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.”
And the word of the LORD {YHWH} came to Jeremiah (whom YHWH has appointed):
“This is what the LORD {YHWH} says: If you⁺ can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time,
then My covenant may also be broken with David (beloved) My servant and with My ministers the Levites who are priests, so that David will not have a son to reign on his throne.

As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David (beloved) and the Levites who minister before Me.”
Moreover, the word of the LORD {YHWH} came to Jeremiah (whom YHWH has appointed):
“Have you not noticed what these people are saying: ‘The LORD {YHWH} has rejected the two families He had chosen’? So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation.
This is what the LORD {YHWH} says: If I have not established My covenant with the day and the night and the fixed order of heaven and earth,

then I would also reject the descendants of Jacob (he grasps the heel) and of My servant David (beloved), so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham (father of many), Isaac (he laughs), and Jacob. For I will restore them from captivity (restore their fortunes) and will have compassion on them.”
